ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the amounts involved and the individuals and organizations responsible.
questions: What is the total amount of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who are the individuals and organizations responsible?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on a critical issue affecting the state's most vulnerable citizens.
